distribution.narrative: Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) lists Yunnan and Xizang for Diamerus fici in the second-edition catalogue. The evidence remains under checklist review; Mainland China is Candidate and Review Status is In review. These literature-reported regions are not presented as confirmed current occurrences.
